summary: Daemon polls hardcoded Supabase backend and executes remote-issued CLI/PTY commands on installer host
details: The package runs as a daemon that, after pairing with a +Ai account, polls a hardcoded Supabase project (syhzpqqvrplaqdipcymw.supabase.co) and executes work dispatched by that backend on the installer's machine. dist/session-runner.js's runRequest handler spawns coding-agent CLIs (Claude, Codex, Kimi, Gemini, Grok) with remote-supplied prompts and working directories, optionally cloning a remote-specified ephemeral_git_remote before execution. dist/capabilities.js and the command-runner module drive PTY login flows that write remote-supplied codes into interactive CLI prompts, install additional npm packages globally via `npm install -g <harness>`, mutate PATH and files under `~/.kimi/config`, and perform runtime updates. Anyone who controls the paired account or the Supabase project can therefore issue arbitrary shell/agent invocations, clone attacker-chosen repositories, install further packages, and establish persistence on the host running the daemon. The network destination is hardcoded to a single Supabase project rather than a user-configurable endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
